Based only on the search results you provided, four power banks are identified as supporting Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, with the Baseus, UGREEN, and Anker models having the clearest U.S. shopping information. The CIO model is also listed, but its supplied purchase links are for Japan.

Qi2.2 25W power banks
1. Baseus PicoGo AM52
Best value
$59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52

10,000 mAh capacity

Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W

45W USB-C wired output; 30W input

Slim aluminum design

The supplied results say it supports 25W wireless charging with compatible iPhones and other Qi2.2 devices. The discount code brings it below the listed prices of the other U.S. options. Sources: Baseus product details, launch coverage

Shop Baseus PicoGo AM52

2. UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank
Price not specified in supplied results

Official Qi2.2 certification from the Wireless Power Consortium

Up to 25W wireless charging

Designed for compatible iPhones and other Qi2.2 devices

UGREEN announced this as the world's first officially Qi2.2-certified power bank on July 15, 2025. The supplied announcement doesn't give a current U.S. price or a direct product purchase URL. Source: UGREEN official announcement

Shop at UGREEN's official website

3. Anker MagGo 2 Pro
$109.99

10,000 mAh capacity

Qi2.2 25W wireless charging

Active cooling fan

45W USB-C recharge, smart display and built-in stand

The supplied Anker listing shows it as a preorder, with shipping estimated for October 21–November 9, 2026. Source: Anker official product page

Buy from Anker US

4. CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K
¥8,980 (Japanese MSRP)

10,000 mAh capacity

Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W

Built-in USB-C cable with up to 35W output

Integrated ring stand and semi-solid-state battery cells

The supplied announcement confirms a June 22, 2026 launch in Japan. A U.S. price or U.S. retail availability is not established by these results. Source: CIO product announcement

Shop on Amazon Japan

Compatibility note: Qi2.2 certification alone doesn't guarantee every phone will charge at 25W. The supplied Baseus results specify 25W for iPhone 16 and later models except the 16e, running iOS 26; iPhone 12–15 are listed at up to 15W. Check your phone's compatibility before buying.

My recommendation: Start with the Baseus PicoGo AM52. It has the strongest combination of confirmed specifications, a stated U.S. price, and a working purchase link in the provided results.
